settings.matugen_path.label: Matugen binary
settings.matugen_path.description: Command name or path of the matugen executable. A bare name is looked up on $PATH.
settings.config_file.label: Matugen config
settings.config_file.description: Optional config.toml used for this run (--config). Leave empty to use matugen's own default.
settings.type.label: Scheme type
settings.type.description: Color scheme generation algorithm Matugen applies to the wallpaper.
settings.mode.label: Mode
settings.mode.description: Generate a light or dark palette, or follow the shell's current light/dark state.
settings.prefer.label: Source color preference
settings.prefer.description: Which wallpaper color seeds the palette when several candidates qualify.
settings.source_index.label: Source color index
settings.source_index.description: Which extracted color to use (0 = most dominant, 4 = least).
settings.contrast.label: Contrast
settings.video_mode.label: Video wallpapers
settings.video_mode.description: Sample a still frame from a video wallpaper with ffmpeg and colour from it. Also follows the mpvpaper plugin's assignments.
settings.ffmpeg_path.label: ffmpeg binary
settings.ffmpeg_path.description: Command name or path of ffmpeg, used to sample video wallpapers.
settings.frame_offset.label: Frame position (s)
settings.frame_offset.description: Where in the video the sampled frame is taken. Falls back to the first frame when the video is shorter.
settings.frame_width.label: Frame width (px)
settings.frame_width.description: The frame is scaled to this width before Matugen reads it. 0 keeps the original size.
settings.assignments_file.label: mpvpaper assignments
settings.assignments_file.description: Leave empty to use $XDG_STATE_HOME/noctalia/mpvpaper/assignments.json, which the Video Wallpaper plugin writes.
settings.shell_wallpaper.label: Hand the frame to the shell
settings.shell_wallpaper.description: Also apply the sampled frame as that output's wallpaper, so the shell's own palette (theme source = wallpaper) follows the video too. This is what the old mpv hook did; it overwrites the output's configured wallpaper path.
settings.extra_args.label: Extra arguments
settings.extra_args.description: Additional matugen flags appended to every run, one per entry.
settings.interval.label: Watch interval (ms)
settings.interval.description: How often the service compares the wallpaper. 1000 ms is a good default; lower values only cost CPU.
settings.run_on_start.label: Apply on start
settings.run_on_start.description: Regenerate once when the plugin loads, so the current settings take effect without waiting for a wallpaper change.
settings.notify_errors.label: Notify on failure
settings.notify_errors.description: Show a notification when matugen exits with an error. Failures are always written to the Noctalia log.
shortcut.refresh.label: Matugen colors
toast.title: Matugen Themer
toast.done: Colors regenerated from the current wallpaper.
toast.missing_file: The wallpaper is not a readable file.
toast.directory: The wallpaper source is a folder; matugen needs a single image.
toast.video: The wallpaper is a video and video sampling is turned off.
toast.no_ffmpeg: ffmpeg was not found. Install it or set its path in the plugin settings.
toast.frame_failed: Could not sample a frame from the video — {error}
toast.missing_binary: matugen was not found. Install it or set its path in the plugin settings.
